verdictEs: ApexSeasons si quieres UX moderna con filtros visuales y comparativas head-to-head rápidas. Drybear's Sheet si necesitas la math raw expuesta directamente — formulas visibles, customizable para casos edge, históricamente authoritative en la community.
verdictEn: ApexSeasons if you want modern UX with visual filters and fast head-to-head comparisons. Drybear's Sheet if you need raw math exposed directly — visible formulas, customizable for edge cases, historically authoritative in the community.

useCases.labelEs: Quick TTK lookup contra purple armor
useCases.labelEn: Quick TTK lookup against purple armor
useCases.reasonEs: ApexSeasons tiene web UI con filter por armor tier que da respuesta en segundos. Drybear es Google Sheets con navegación entre tabs — más lento para queries quick.
useCases.reasonEn: ApexSeasons has web UI with armor tier filter giving answers in seconds. Drybear is Google Sheets with tab navigation — slower for quick queries.

useCases.labelEn: Verify balance discussion claims on Reddit

useCases.reasonEn: Drybear's Sheet is historically the authoritative source cited in Reddit posts and video guides. 'Source: Drybear TTK Calc' is community-recognized shorthand.

useCases.reasonEs: ApexSeasons tiene comparison view side-by-side. Drybear requires Make a Copy y customize manualmente, friction mayor.
useCases.reasonEn: ApexSeasons has a side-by-side comparison view. Drybear requires Make a Copy and manual customization — higher friction.

useCases.reasonEs: El Sheet expone formulas directamente — puedes Make a Copy y editar values, attachments, modifiers manualmente. ApexSeasons tiene filtros pero no permite custom math.
useCases.reasonEn: The Sheet exposes formulas directly — you can Make a Copy and edit values, attachments, modifiers manually. ApexSeasons has filters but doesn't allow custom math.

useCases.reasonEs: ApexSeasons tiene editorial team con update cadence consistente (1-3 days post-patch). Drybear depende de un solo maintainer (Christopher Mykles), lag puede ser 1-2 semanas.
useCases.reasonEn: ApexSeasons has an editorial team with consistent update cadence (1-3 days post-patch). Drybear depends on a single maintainer (Christopher Mykles), lag can be 1-2 weeks.
